children.translated_text: (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>, Longer Chapter) <s>Śaikṣa</s> 1: 'I will wear the lower robe (<s>nivāsana</s>) evenly wrapped around' — this is the training to be practiced. //

children.text: (PrMoSū-LCh)Śai.2-7 nātyutkṛṣṭaṃ nātyapakṛṣṭaṃ na hastiśuṇḍakaṃ na tālavṛndakaṃ na kulmāṣapiṇḍakaṃ na nāgaśīrṣakaṃ nivāsanaṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā //
children.translated_text: (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>, Longer Chapter) <s>Śaikṣa</s> 2-7: 'I will wear the lower robe neither too high nor too low, not like an elephant's trunk, not like a palm-frond, not like a lump of porridge, not like a serpent's hood' — this is the training to be practiced. //

children.text: (PrMoSū-LCh)Śai.8 parimaṇḍalaṃ cīvaraṃ prāvariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā //

children.text: (PrMoSū-LCh)Śai.9-10 nātyutkṛṣṭaṃ nātyapakṛṣṭaṃ cīvaraṃ prāvariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā //
children.translated_text: (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>, Longer Chapter) <s>Śaikṣa</s> 9-10: 'I will cover myself with the upper robe neither too high nor too low' — this is the training to be practiced. //

children.text: (PrMoSū-LCh)Śai.11-15 susaṃvṛtā supraticchannā alpaśabdā anutkṣiptacakṣuṣo yugamātradarśino 'ntargṛhaṃ gamiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā //
children.translated_text: (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>, Longer Chapter) <s>Śaikṣa</s> 11-15: 'Well-covered, well-concealed, making little noise, with eyes not cast upward, looking only a yoke's distance [ahead] — thus will I enter the inner house' — this is the training to be practiced. //

children.translated_text: (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>, Longer Chapter) <s>Śaikṣa</s> 21-25: 'Not leaping, not striding, not crouching, not with alternating crouching, not with arms akimbo — thus will I enter the inner house' — this is the training to be practiced. //
